page.layout: One column of short list lines, with year numbers set on their own lines between groups of names. A running title stands at the top above the list. Nothing is printed below the list in this part.; One column of officer lists by year, from 1634 to 1640, with the governor's line below. Fragments of left-margin notes at the left edge. Running head and page number at the top right. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.head: G V B E R N A T O

page.notes: The year 1629 and 1630 are set in old-style figures, with the 9 and 0 descending; read as 1629 and 1630. The line after "Henricus Casimirus" is in italics. The heading "GVBERNATO" is in spaced capitals; its ending is printed as "GVBERNATO" and is read from the visible letters. The final lines of several names are printed at the right edge of the scan and are copied only as far as they can be read. Left-margin fragments are read from the scan edge only. Their exact line position is approximate. The colon at the left edge beside the 1638 entries is not transcribed.
